# 100.00 USD bought for 135.00 CAD, which gives the USD bank a cost basis.
#
# What it is for: an account whose bases still have a balance. A payment block
# cannot spend one, because its bank split is written by `ApplyPayment` and so
# has nowhere
# to name the basis it draws from — and the account has to have a basis for
# that refusal to have anything to refuse.
#
# Bought at 1.35 rather than the 1.40 the bill beside it was booked at, so
# settling that bill from this cash realizes something and the figures are
# told apart by their value rather than by their sign.
#
# Uses the accounts from fx_usd_bill_cad_expense.txt.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_spending_what_a_settlement_brought_in.py.
2026-02-01 * "Buy 100 USD at 1.35"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.35"
		value: "135.00"
	Assets:Bank -135.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "-135.00"
